{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if any of the 6 QA orders (with revenue=999999.99) are in the filtered group
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
qa_in_filtered = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (qa_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

print(f"Number of QA orders in the filtered group: {len(qa_in_filtered)}")
print(qa_in_filtered[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue']])"}
